title: Required sign agrees with the assigned bit
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let a path on $n$ binary coordinates have terminal output in the sign group $\mathbb{Z}^{\times}$. If coordinate $i$ belongs to the path's support and its assigned bit is $b\in\mathbb{F}_2$, then the sign required at $i$ is the sign encoding of $b$, namely $(-1)^b$.
hypotheses_covered: A path with output in the sign group
A coordinate i in the path's support
The path assigns b at i
